# Crosstalk-limited null study

## Summary
- Added injectable input and output crosstalk matrices to `N4x4_T8` while preserving the measured matrices as defaults.
- Added a bootstrap analysis module for PHOB with perfect cophasing and an ideal camera.
- Generated energy-conserving random crosstalk matrices using anti-Hermitian matrix exponentials and matched the requested off-diagonal maximum.
- Added mean, median, 5th/95th percentile, minimum, and maximum plot statistics before and after Hooke&Jeeves calibration.

## Files modified
- `src/phise/classes/archs/n4x4_t8.py`
- `src/analysis/crosstalk_vs_null.py`
- `tests/unit/test_crosstalk_vs_null.py`

## Validation
- Energy conservation test: passed.
- PHOB plus Hooke&Jeeves smoke test: passed.
- Full test suite: 2 passed.
- Physical validation: generated matrices satisfy `C.conj().T @ C = I` within `1e-12`, so total field power is conserved for every input.

## Notes
- Crosstalk levels are field-amplitude coefficients expressed as fractions in the API and percentages on the plot.
- The existing unresolved `expected_outputs_jit` diagnostic in `N4x4_T8.expected_outputs` was not introduced by this change.
